disease_label_per_paper: Nocardia in an Immunocompetent Host Masquerading As Lung Cancer
presentation_summary: Older woman with COPD on home oxygen presented with several weeks of fatigue, subjective fever, chills, productive cough with blood-streaked sputum, and weight loss.
Initial presentation was afebrile but tachycardic, with oxygen saturation 88% on 2 L nasal oxygen and leukocytosis.

Chest imaging showed left lower lobe consolidation/effusion and CT showed a large infiltrating left lower-lobe mass with poorly defined right-lung nodules, initially raising concern for lung malignancy.
Sputum culture grew Nocardia; HIV test was negative and head CT showed no brain involvement.
